title: Mosul Dam, Bassetki, Zakho & Pira Delal
full_text:
Early morning visiting the lake of Mosul Dam, the largest dam in Iraq.
Head to Bassetki Village, a site which has been occupied since the Bronze Age.
Head to Zakho and visit the Zakho fort, also known as Qishla Duhok.
Head to visit the Pira Delal, locally known as the Roman Bridge.
Head back to Duhok.
